description: This file contains SCSS mixins that define grid system behaviors for a Bootstrap-like layout, including container sizing, row and column layout, and responsive breakpoints.

methods.name: make-container
methods.description: Creates a container with full width and horizontal padding based on grid gutter width.

methods.name: make-container-max-widths
methods.description: Sets maximum container widths at different breakpoints.

methods.name: make-row
methods.description: Defines a flex row with wrapping and negative margins to account for gutter spacing.

methods.name: make-col-ready
methods.description: Prepares columns to be flexible by setting relative positioning, full width, minimum height, and padding.

methods.name: make-col
methods.description: Defines flexible columns with specified size and maximum width based on total columns.

methods.name: make-col-offset
methods.description: Offsets columns by a specified number of grid columns.
